description: This line plot illustrates the loss metrics for two experimental setups, Ex1 and Ex2, across 60,000 training steps during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis represents the training step, ranging from 0 to 60,000 on a linear scale, labeled "Step". The y-axis represents the loss value on a logarithmic scale, spanning from 2 × 10⁰ to 1.2 × 10¹, labeled "Loss". The solid blue line with circle markers, labeled "Ex1 Loss", begins at approximately 4 × 10⁰ and steadily declines to just below 2 × 10⁰ by step 60,000. The solid cyan line with circle markers, labeled "Ex2 Loss", starts at around 3 × 10⁰ and stabilizes near 2.5 × 10⁰ after approximately 20,000 steps. The dashed blue line with circle markers, labeled "Ex1 Validation Loss", initiates above 1.1 × 10¹ and drops sharply to 3 × 10⁰ by step 10,000, then remains relatively stable. The dashed cyan line with circle markers, labeled "Ex2 Validation Loss", begins slightly below 1.1 × 10¹ and decreases to 4 × 10⁰ by step 20,000, remaining consistently higher than the Ex1 Validation Loss throughout the training process.
caption_used: Loss comparison of Ex1 and Ex2 during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The plot shows that Ex1 Loss starts at approximately 4 × 10⁰ and steadily declines to less than 2 × 10⁰ by 60,000 steps, while Ex2 Loss begins at around 3 × 10⁰ and stabilizes at 2.5 × 10⁰ after 20,000 steps. Ex1 Validation Loss starts above 1.1 × 10¹ and decreases sharply to 3 × 10⁰ by 10,000 steps, then stabilizes. Ex2 Validation Loss begins slightly below 1.1 × 10¹ and declines to 4 × 10⁰ by 20,000 steps, remaining higher than Ex1 Validation Loss throughout the training process.
